answer: Require in-person notarization before an identity gains weight: a licensed notary checks a photo ID face to face, logs the session, and signs a certificate binding that person to one identity. A notary certifying the same person twice risks their licence, so the check cannot scale. Seen through a prism, trust passes through a human gatekeeper, not self-asserted data. A sybil farm must send a person to an office per fake, paying travel and fees, while a spiral of repeat appointments for one face exposes it. Presence is the marble floor: one proven forgery revokes the whole cluster.
